cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay while you tell your family you lost your job. In return, you'll hear me admit something equally frightening tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm setting fair terms. Your request for support is approved; equal honesty is the repayment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know if I can hear anything else frightening yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That admission is accepted as an installment. Tomorrow you may start by asking what I'm afraid to tell you. I expect you to stay too.
